system.name: YouTube
system.description: Creators upload videos that are transcoded for streaming; viewers find them by search, watch them at a bitrate that suits their connection and see how many times each was viewed.

services.name: Video lifecycle worker
services.description: Video authority consumes processing events, conditionally records lifecycle state and commits ready plus publication outbox together. Fixed deadlines fail overdue jobs; terminal states never reopen.

components.name: Processing consumer
components.purpose: Consumes processing results; inbox receipt, conditional transition and publication intent commit before ack.

requires.reason: An event consumer needs a consume connection from a queue.

components.name: Publication outbox publisher
components.purpose: Relays only publication-events rows from committed ready state; confirms before marking sent, duplicate delivery permitted.

requires.reason: An event publisher needs a publish connection to a queue.
A transactional outbox needs a database connection.

components.name: Lifecycle writer
components.purpose: Reads and conditionally transitions private Video state; writes inbox and committed-ready publication outbox atomically.

requires.reason: Data access needs a database connection.

services.name: Identity
services.description: Signs creators and viewers in and issues the tokens the services verify.

services.name: Search API
services.description: Finds videos by title, description and channel.

components.name: Video search
components.purpose: Queries the index by title, description and channel, a page at a time.

services.name: Search indexer
services.description: Discovery projection consumes committed VideoPublished events and indexes ready-public videos with monotonic publication versions.

components.name: Publication consumer
components.purpose: Consumes committed VideoPublished events only, with bounded retries.

requires.reason: An event consumer needs a consume connection from a queue.

components.name: Index writer
components.purpose: Adds the playable video's title, description and channel to the search index.

services.name: Transcoder
services.description: Media worker with no SQL credential. Checks the original fingerprint, runs a fixed CPU 360p/720p HLS ladder and thumbnail, then confirms started/succeeded/failed processing events.

components.name: Job consumer
components.purpose: Takes one upload job at a time with bounded retries.

requires.reason: An event consumer needs a consume connection from a queue.

components.name: Processing result publisher
components.purpose: Confirms bounded started/succeeded/failed results with stable job/attempt/type event identities; no SQL outbox.

requires.reason: An event publisher needs a publish connection to a queue.

components.name: Segmenter and encoder
components.purpose: Checks original size/hash then runs fixed CPU H.264/AAC 360p and 720p HLS encoding; no speculative task DAG.

components.name: Packager
components.purpose: Stores the segments with an HLS playlist per rendition and one master playlist.

components.name: Thumbnailer
components.purpose: Picks frames and stores them as the video's thumbnails, at full size.

services.name: Upload & status API
services.description: Creator-authorized resumable uploads and private status. Video authority allocates lifecycle state and commits pending plus one processing-job outbox intent after verified object completion.

components.name: Creator check
components.purpose: Accepts only signed-in creators, by Identity's token.

components.name: Job outbox publisher
components.purpose: Relays the stable processing job committed with pending state; confirms before marking sent.

requires.reason: An event publisher needs a publish connection to a queue.
A transactional outbox needs a database connection.

components.name: Multipart uploads
components.purpose: Starts a multipart upload, signs a URL for each part, lists the parts that arrived so the creator can resume, and completes it.

components.name: Upload state writer
components.purpose: Video runtime metadata_upload credential; allocates private upload state and commits verified pending plus job outbox. No owner password.

requires.reason: Data access needs a database connection.

services.name: View counter
services.description: Deduplicates each accepted played event and increments its video total in one transaction, without buffering.

components.name: View consumer
components.purpose: Consumes one event per callback with bounded retries.

requires.reason: An event consumer needs a consume connection from a queue.

components.name: Receipt and increment
components.purpose: Deduplicates each event receipt and increments by one in the same transaction.

components.name: Count writer
components.purpose: Writes private receipts/totals as counts_writer; exposes only public totals to Watch.

requires.reason: Data access needs a database connection.

services.name: Watch API
services.description: Gives the player a video's details, playlist and view count, and records each view.

components.name: Details cache
components.purpose: Caches only positive ready-public metadata for one hour; single-flight fill, primary fallback and separately fresh counts.

requires.reason: A cache reader needs a cache connection.

components.name: View count reader
components.purpose: Reads a video's view count.

requires.reason: Data access needs a database connection.

components.name: Details reader
components.purpose: Reads only ready-public metadata from the primary public view.

requires.reason: Data access needs a database connection.

components.name: View publisher
components.purpose: Immediately confirms one ready-video played event; no SQL outbox or buffering.

requires.reason: An event publisher needs a publish connection to a queue.

resources.name: Processing events
resources.description: Started, succeeded or failed results from Transcoder to Video lifecycle only; runtime processing-events. Results do not authorize search publication.

resources.name: Metadata cache
resources.description: Videos' details by video ID, filled by the Watch API on a miss and kept an hour.

resources.name: Metadata database
resources.description: Private Video lifecycle, uploads, processing inbox and job/publication outbox. Watch reads only the ready-public view; runtime writer roles are explicit and owners are migration-only.

resources.name: Original videos
resources.description: Each video as the creator uploaded it, kept to transcode again.

resources.name: Publication events
resources.description: Committed ready-public VideoPublished projection, sent by lifecycle outbox after the owner transaction; runtime publication-events feeds only Search indexer.

resources.name: Search index
resources.description: Playable videos by title, description and channel.

resources.name: Transcoded videos
resources.description: Each video's segments at every resolution, its HLS playlists and its thumbnails.

resources.name: Upload jobs
resources.description: Stable video/job/logical-attempt identities and private original fingerprint, committed with pending state through Upload outbox; no user text is trusted from worker results.

resources.name: Local video edge
resources.description: Local reverse proxy/cache serving video segments, playlists and full-size thumbnails from Transcoded videos. This local substitute is not a globally distributed CDN; thumbnail resizing is disabled.

resources.name: View counts
resources.description: Private receipt deduplication and immediate asynchronous transactional increments. Watch reads only public totals.

resources.name: View events
resources.description: Views, from the Watch API to the View counter, keyed by video.
